mapper.insert: insert into auth_refresh_token(openid, token_hash, token_family_id, status, expire_time, create_time, update_time) values(#{openid}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenFamilyId}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update auth_refresh_token set status = 'USED', revoked_at = now(), replaced_by_token_hash = #{replacedByTokenHash}, update_time = now() where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update auth_refresh_token set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = ifnull(revoked_at, now()), update_time = now() where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update auth_refresh_token set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = ifnull(revoked_at, now()), update_time = now() where token_family_id = #{tokenFamilyId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
